name: [🔥NEW SNIPER] Sniper Arena
desc:
Welcome to Sniper Arena — Fast-paced sniper battles. Play fair. Win with skill.
Skins are cosmetic only — no stat boosts, no pay-to-win.
Join Ranked matches and defeat other players to earn awesome rewards!
Cheating results in a permanent ban. No second chances.

🔫 Eliminate enemies with your sniper!
🔑 Unlock more snipers!
📦 Open crates to get more skins!
🤑 Sell your skins on the market to earn CASH!
💵 Use CASH to unlock premium skins!
📈 Experience a real player-driven market — get awesome skins even without spending!

🎮 Available on Desktop, Phones, Tablets, XBOX, & PlayStation 5!
⭐ Premium players earn +20% in-match Credits!
👥 Play with friends to earn +20% in-match Credits!

Controls:
💻PC
LMB: Shoot
RMB: Aim
V: Inspect
Ctrl / C: Crouch & Slide

🎮Controller
R2: Shoot
L2: Aim
Y: Inspect

📱Mobile
Supports auto-lock

🚫 Cheating will result in a permanent ban. There are no second chances!
